answer: Hold each job's payment in escrow until a jury grades the delivered work, and publish the failure record together with the full submission text. Duplicates are caught by replaying the payload against the archive rather than by checking the name, because names are free and payloads are not. The edge case that matters is an identity copying a published failure record, and the replay index catches that too. One good answer resubmitted three hundred times costs three hundred bonds. The crystal is the payload hash, the jade is the bond, the orchard only grows what passes.
